title: tab/create
description: Open a windowless tab (CEF's off-screen rendering, OnPaint with BGRA pixels) at `url`. Before answering, the engine sends tab/resized with the tab's first shared-memory region, and from then on tab/frame for every painted frame.

url.description: Any URL Chromium loads, including data: URLs; `about:blank` for none.

width.description: The view's width in CSS pixels.

height.description: The view's height in CSS pixels.

scale.description: Device scale factor: device pixels per CSS pixel. Default 1.

frameRate.description: The windowless frame rate CEF paints at, at most. Default 60.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).
